mono.provider: Google Fonts IBM Plex Mono v20

css_mono_cjk_fallback: IBM Plex Mono alias uses an IBM Sans SC subset for characters missing from the original Mono, avoiding system CJK fallback.
modified_font_names: Primary internal names renamed Binance Video Sans SC / Mono / Mono CJK because Plex is reserved; CSS aliases retain existing page family contracts.
sans_symbol_companions: Official Sans SC lacks U+2212 and U+2713; IBM Mono supplies the two glyphs via unicode-range companions, including the closest available Mono 600 for Sans 700. No system symbol font is required.
